post.description:
Asks for a term the dictionary does not resolve. 409 when it already does. Session
cookie only.
RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe: turns off only the group the token names.

get.description: Up to 20 cities whose name matches, optionally within one country.
Readable with a session or an API key.

put.description: Session cookie only: an agent must not grant itself the right to apply.

post.description:
Turns a catalogue job, a vacancy URL or pasted text into a job the tailoring workspace
can open. 404 for an unknown slug, 422 for a URL with no readable vacancy. Session
cookie only.

get.description: `data` is null before the first save.
With a session or an API key. Zeroes when the gateway cannot be read.
One page, newest first. A page param that does not read falls back to its default.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A substring of the company name.

post.description: Adds the companies the names identify and reports what it could not resolve.

delete.description: A company that was not on the list is not an error.

204.description: There is no content to send for this request, but the headers may be useful.

get.description: What each plan allows and what it costs, read from the configuration metering uses.
Search-box suggestions. 503 when search is not configured.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 1 to 20, default 5. A value that does not read falls back to the default.

schema.description: A single item that read query params: `{"data": ...}`, plus `meta` when one was dropped.

get.description: A card is a person: cached privately only, so leaving takes effect at once.
The member's photo, blurred past recognition. The original is never served.

agents_may_apply.description: Whether an agent acting for the account may submit applications. Absent reads as false.

value.description: The city's canonical name, the value the filters take.

request_count.description: How many people have asked for this term.

EmailPrefs.description: The preference page's state: the address mail goes to and the three switches.

EmailPrefsSearch.description: One email digest subscription the switches govern.

EmailPrefsTokenUpdate.description:
The token-opened patch. The token rides in the body so it never reaches an access
log. Optional on the wire because a missing token must be refused exactly like a
forged one (404), not with a 400 that tells the two apart.

EmailPrefsUpdate.description: A patch: an absent switch keeps its stored value. Searches can only be turned off.

IgnoredMeta.description: The meta of a single-item answer, sent only to carry a warning.

IgnoredParam.description:
A query param the endpoint did not read: unknown, or known but unreadable
(`min_years=lots`). Either way the answer is wider than the caller asked for.

JobDescriptionSource.description: Exactly one of `job_slug`, `url` and `text`; anything else is a 400.

ignored_params.description: Absent when every param was read.

ListMeta.description: A page of a filtered list, with what the filter dropped.

PageMeta.description: Where a page sits in the whole list.

PeriodDate.description: A year, with a month when the CV gives one.

amount_cents.description: The smallest currency unit, as the payment provider stores it.

default.description: The price a new subscriber is sold unless they choose another.

tier.description: The plan the price buys: `pro`, `ultra`, `api` or `api_data`.

limit.description: The daily ceiling; with `unlimited`, the fair-use guard behind it.

PlanTierAllowance.description: What one tier allows for one feature in a UTC day.

enforced.description: The features whose ceiling refuses today.

Problem.description:
Every refusal, whatever its status: `{"error": msg}`. `code` is set only where a
client branches on the reason (the auth flows).

authorized_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes the candidate may work in.

privacy_consent.description: A standing agreement to an employer form's privacy terms; false asks each time.

ScreeningAnswers.description: Answers an application form asks for, saved once and reused. Each field is optional.

authorized_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes the candidate may work in.

privacy_consent.description: A standing agreement to an employer form's privacy terms; false asks each time.

clear.description: Field names to clear. An unknown name is a 400.

jobs.description: How many open jobs the suggestion finds.

slug.description: The dictionary slug, when the part is one.

SuggestionPart.description: One recognised piece of the query: a dictionary term, or text still being typed.

biggest_challenge_note.description: Kept only while `other` is among the challenges.

SurveyResponses.description: The onboarding survey. Each field is optional.

TalentCard.description: The anonymised card: only what a dictionary can vouch for.

TalentEducation.description: One education entry: the degree level a dictionary resolved, and the year.

facets.description:
Facet name → value → member count. A count of -1 means the value is present but
held by too few members to say how many; 0 means nobody holds it.

stats.description: Ranged facets. The catalogue has none, so this is always empty.

TalentFacets.description: How many members stand behind each filter value.

timezone_region.description: The part of the zone before the slash; the `tz` filter reads it.

has_photo.description: Whether GET /talent/{handle}/photo has something to serve.

TalentRole.description: One role of a work history, with everything nameable removed.

period.description: The plan day the figures cover, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

Usage.description: Today's AI use on the account's own model credential. No money: the plan bounds use.

names.description: Company names or slugs, one per entry. An empty list is refused with a 400.

unmatched.description: Entries that did not resolve to exactly one company, as typed.

max.description: How many companies one list may hold.
